irac.issue: Whether the land acquisition proceedings can be held to have lapsed under Section 24 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, when possession of the land has been taken and compensation has been paid to the landowners, but the award has not been made under Section 11 of the Act.
irac.rule: The provisions of Section 24 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, and the effect of possession being taken and compensation being paid on the lapse of land acquisition proceedings.
irac.application: The Court applied the provisions of Section 24 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, to the facts of the case and held that when possession of the land has been taken and compensation has been paid to the landowners, the land acquisition proceedings cannot be held to have lapsed.
irac.conclusion: The Court held that the land acquisition proceedings had not lapsed and the respondents were not entitled to restitution of their lands.
